# An impact burst (generated by make_env.py): eight tiny unlit cubes on a 0.3 m sphere. Origin at its centre.

material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S2 --size 0.08 --location -0.048 -0.001 -0.296
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S3 --size 0.08 --location 0.158 0.088 0.239
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S4 --size 0.08 --location -0.222 -0.200 0.033
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S5 --size 0.08 --location -0.086 0.082 -0.275
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S6 --size 0.08 --location -0.262 0.081 0.122
material assign Spark
add mesh cube --name S7 --size 0.08 --location 0.148 0.224 0.135
